questions.question: What shape should one scalar target per observation have for predictions of shape \((n,)\)?
questions.explanation: Use matching \((n,)\) shapes. A column target can silently broadcast into pairwise residuals.
optionFeedback: Subtracting \((n,)\) from \((n,1)\) broadcasts into an \((n,n)\) array. Check the residual shape before taking its mean.
Use matching \((n,)\) shapes. A column target can silently broadcast into pairwise residuals.
The targets are indexed by observations, not features. There must be one target for each of the n predictions.
